label: Passive Voice
description: A 20-question check on the passive-voice lessons.

questions.prompt: Which passive construction does «Новый дом строится на нашей улице.» use?
options: An active sentence with no passive at all
questions.explain: Строится is строить plus -ся, the imperfective reflexive passive meaning 'is being built'.

questions.prompt: What does «Книги продаются здесь каждый день.» mean?
options: The books sell something every day
The books are being sold here every day
Someone buys books here every day
The books will be sold here tomorrow
questions.explain: Продаются is продавать plus -ся, an imperfective reflexive passive: the books are the thing being sold.

questions.prompt: Which construction does «Этот дом был построен очень давно.» use?
options: Periphrastic быть + short past passive participle
questions.explain: Был построен pairs masculine был with the short participle построен — the periphrastic быть passive meaning 'was built'.

questions.prompt: In «Этот роман написан известным автором.», what case is the agent известным автором in?
questions.explain: The passive agent — who did the action — stands in the instrumental case: автором tells us who wrote the novel.

questions.prompt: In «Наш дом построен опытными рабочими.», the workers (рабочими) appear in the instrumental because they are the —
questions.explain: The doers of a passive action are named in the instrumental: рабочими are the agents who built the house.

questions.prompt: Why is it была (not был) in «Эта книга была написана за месяц.»?
options: Because быть is always feminine in the passive
Because книга is a feminine subject, so быть and the participle agree as feminine
Because the action is still ongoing
questions.explain: In the быть passive, both была and the short participle написана agree with the feminine subject книга.

questions.prompt: Which construction does «Магазин будет открыт завтра в девять.» express?
options: A future periphrastic passive (будет + short participle)
questions.explain: Будет открыт uses future будет with the short participle открыт, meaning 'will be opened'.

questions.prompt: In «Завтрак был приготовлен моей мамой.», who or what is the agent, and in what case?
questions.explain: Мамой stands in the instrumental as the one who prepared the breakfast — the passive agent.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a reflexive -ся passive (not a быть + participle passive)?
options: Все окна были вымыты к празднику.
questions.explain: Обсуждается is обсуждать plus -ся, the reflexive passive; the other three use были/была plus a short participle.

questions.prompt: In «Этот вопрос сейчас обсуждается комиссией.», the agent комиссией is in the instrumental and names —
questions.explain: Even in a reflexive -ся passive, the agent goes in the instrumental: комиссией is the commission doing the discussing.

questions.prompt: The active clause «Рабочие построили дом» becomes which passive?
questions.explain: The passive recasts дом as subject with был построен (быть + short participle); рабочие become the demoted agent.

questions.prompt: Which short participle form correctly agrees in «Эта картина ___ талантливым художником.»?
questions.explain: Картина is feminine, so the short participle takes the feminine -а ending: нарисована.

questions.prompt: In «Это письмо было написано вчера утром.», why is the participle написано (neuter)?
options: Because письмо is a neuter subject
Because all past passives default to neuter
Because the action is in the future
questions.explain: Письмо is neuter, so both было and написано take the neuter form to agree with it.

questions.prompt: What does «Все окна были вымыты к празднику.» tell us?
options: The windows washed themselves for the holiday
The windows will be washed for the holiday
All the windows were washed by the holiday
Someone is washing the windows now
questions.explain: Были вымыты is the plural быть passive: the windows (окна) were the things washed, completed by the holiday.

questions.prompt: In «Письмо было прочитано моим другом.», the friend (другом) is in the instrumental as —
options: the agent who read the letter
the place the letter was read
questions.explain: Другом stands in the instrumental as the reader — the agent behind the passive action.

questions.prompt: Which plural short participle correctly fills «Деньги ___ в дороге.» (past passive)?
questions.explain: Деньги is plural, so both the copula and participle take plural forms: были потеряны.

questions.prompt: How does «Свежий хлеб печётся рано утром.» form its passive?
options: an active verb with no passive
questions.explain: Печётся is печь plus -ся, the imperfective reflexive passive meaning 'is being baked'.

questions.prompt: In «Работа уже сделана и проверена.» there is no был/была. What does that signal?
options: It is a present-tense passive with a zero (unstated) copula
It is actually an active sentence
The participle is in the wrong case
questions.explain: With no overt быть, the copula is zero: the short participles сделана и проверена give a present-state passive 'is done and checked'.

questions.prompt: The active clause «Маша написала письмо» turns into which passive?
questions.explain: Письмо rises to subject with было написано (быть + short participle); Маша becomes the implied agent.

questions.prompt: Which sentence puts the agent in the instrumental case?
questions.explain: Only «миллионами людей» names an agent, and it stands in the instrumental as the readers behind the action.
